sn46.30:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sumbhesu viharati setakannāma sumbhānaṃ nigamo.
sn46.30:1.2: atha kho āyasmā udāyi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. pe. ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā udāyi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca.
sn46.30:2.2: yāva bahukārāpi me bhante bhagavati pemañca gāravo ca hiri ca ottappañca
sn46.30:2.3: ahañhi bhante pubbe āgārikabhūto samāno abahukato ahosiṃ dhammena abahukato saṅghena
sn46.30:2.4: so khvāhaṃ bhagavati pemañca gāravaṃ ca hiriṃ ca ottappaṃ ca sampassamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ
sn46.30:2.6: iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo
sn46.30:2.10: iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamoti.
sn46.30:3.1: so khvāhaṃ bhante suññāgāragato imesaṃ pañcupādānakkhandhānaṃ ukkujjāvakujjaṃ samparivattanto idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
sn46.30:3.2: dhammo ca me bhante abhisameto maggo ca me paṭiladdho
sn46.30:3.3: yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati yathāhaṃ
sn46.30:3.4: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānissāmi.
sn46.30:4.1: satisambojjhaṅgo me bhante paṭiladdho yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati yathāhaṃ
sn46.30:4.2: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānissāmi. pe.
sn46.30:4.3: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo me bhante paṭiladdho yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati yathāhaṃ
sn46.30:4.4: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānissāmi.
sn46.30:4.5: ayaṃ kho me bhante maggo paṭiladdho yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati yathāhaṃ
sn46.30:4.6: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānissāmīti.
sn46.30:5.2: eso hi te udāyi maggo paṭiladdho yo te bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ tathattāya upanessati yathā tvaṃ
sn46.30:5.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānissasīti.
